item.tib: dbyangs can sgra mdo'i 'grel pa rgyal yum bzang bza' ring btsun gyi dgongs bcud dpyod ldan bye ba'i mgul rgyan srid gsum dga' ba'i snying nor
item.coloph: 'jigs med nam mkha' (khyung sprul g.yung drung rgyal mtshan) deng skabs gnas dus blo dang mtshams par sgra mdo kun gyi snying po gnad 'dus go sla ba zhig bgyis na legs zhes/ smon rgyal nam mkha' grags pa dang / spa tshang nyi 'bum sprul sku rin po che dang / don sgom mkhan brtson 'grus rgyal mtshan rin po che dang / dge slong bstan 'dzin dbang grags sogs tshad gsum zung ldan gyi bla ma du ma dang / rang slob bon chos kyi grwa slob mang pos bskul phyir/ sgra mdo kun gyi don 'dus pa dbyangs can ma'i rtsa ba la/ 'grel srid gsum dga' ba'i snying nor zhes bya ba 'di dang / de'i gnad bsdus rtsa ba'i re'u mig thogs med nam mkha'i gru gzings dang / byings sgrub nor bu'i mgul rgyan bcas le'u tshad med bzhi yi grangs ldan pod gcig sbram pa 'di nyid/ snyigs dus kyi kho bo rgya bod skad gnyis smra ba gshen gyi btsun pa 'jigs med nam mkha'i rdo rje'am rgyal kun dgyes pa'i blo gros zhes bya bas/ mi 'jed zhing mgon ston mchog gshen rab chen po gzugs sku'i snang brnyan bzhad nas/ 'byung ldan sum brgya'i nang tshan shing pho rta lo'i smin drug zla ba'i dral tshes bco lngar dbu 'dzug ste/ de lo'i rgyal zla'i bco lngar mjug yongs su grub par bgyis pas/ dge legs gang des brda sprod rgya mtsho'i bstan pa me ltar 'bar zhing / mthar thug 'gro kun tshangs dbyangs drug cu'i dpal la mnga' brnyes te dag chen gdod ma'i gzhi ru byang chub pa'i rgyu ru gyur cig/
